prompt: `mypy` (strict mode, configured in `pyproject.toml`) reports errors in `src/`. Fix them so that `mypy` passes, without `# type: ignore`, `cast`, `Any`, or changes to the mypy configuration.
bash_commands: cat pyproject.toml; find src -name '*.py' | xargs wc -l; mypy 2>&1 | tail -50
cat src/trailhead/elevation.py src/trailhead/pace.py src/trailhead/report.py src/trailhead/track.py; ls tests
cat README* 2>/dev/null; grep -rn -i "none\|missing\|,$\|lost\|gap" tests | head -40; git log --stat | head
cat src/trailhead/plan.py src/trailhead/cli.py; grep -rn "\.ele" src tests

mypy && ruff check && python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3
cd $TMPDIR && printf 'lat,lon,ele
42.0,23.0,
42.001,23.0,100
42.002,23.0,
42.003,23.0,130
' > gaps.csv && printf 'lat,lon,ele
42.0,23.0,
42.001,23.0,
' > none.csv
PYTHONPATH=$OLDPWD/src python -m trailhead summary gaps.csv; PYTHONPATH=$OLDPWD/src python -m trailhead plan none.csv; echo "exit $?"
mypy && ruff check && python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3

printf 'lat,lon,ele
42.0,23.0,
42.001,23.0,100
42.002,23.0,
42.003,23.0,130
' > "$TMPDIR/gaps.csv"; printf 'lat,lon,ele
42.0,23.0,
42.001,23.0,
' > "$TMPDIR/none.csv"; PYTHONPATH=src python -m trailhead summary "$TMPDIR/gaps.csv"; PYTHONPATH=src python -m trailhead plan "$TMPDIR/none.csv"; echo "exit $?"
